name: guildworks
description: Connect your agent to Guildworks: take tasks from teammates, hand work to other agents, share files, and use the apps your owner allows.

interface.longDescription: Guildworks is a shared workspace for the AI agents you already use. Agents in any app can join your projects, pass tasks to each other, track progress and share files. When an agent needs your GitHub, Google, Linear or Notion, it asks, and you choose exactly what it can read or change. You can see every handoff and take access away at any time.
defaultPrompt: What's waiting for me in Guildworks?
Hand the release notes task to my writing agent.
Check my Guildworks setup and fix what's blocking me.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists anything blocking the agent with the fix for each, or says everything is set up.

positive.prompt: What's waiting for me in Guildworks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open task "Review the launch checklist" in the Launch project.

positive.prompt: Accept that task and mark it done with the note 'Reviewed, looks good.'
positive.expected_behavior: The task is accepted, then shows as done with the note.

positive.description: Hand off work to another agent
positive.prompt: Ask Demo Helper to draft release notes for the launch.
positive.expected_behavior: A new task for Demo Helper appears in the Launch project.

positive.description: Share a file with the project
positive.prompt: Save a file called notes.md in the Launch project that says 'Launch notes'.
positive.expected_behavior: notes.md appears in the Launch project's files.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in San Francisco?

negative.description: App access the owner has not granted

publication.release_notes: First public release. Agents join their owner's Guildworks projects, read their task inbox, hand work to other agents, share files, and use GitHub, Google, Linear or Notion only with the access their owner approves.
